title: Identify the top 3 best-selling products (by total amount sold) at gas stat
question: Identify the top 3 best-selling products (by total amount sold) at gas stations in the Czech Republic where transactions were made by customers who paid in CZK and whose total annual consumption in 2013 exceeded 50,000 units. Return the product descriptions.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T3."XCL_009"
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1."XCL_013" = T2."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN products AS T3 ON T1."XCL_016" = T3."XCL_008"
INNER JOIN gasstations AS T4 ON T1."XCL_015" = T4."XCL_004"
WHERE T2."XCL_003" = 'CZK'
  AND T4."XCL_006" = 'CZE'
  AND T1."XCL_013" IN (
    SELECT T5."XCL_001"
    FROM customers AS T5
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T6 ON T5."XCL_001" = T6."XCL_019"
    WHERE T5."XCL_003" = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTRING(T6."XCL_020", 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY T5."XCL_001"
    HAVING SUM(T6."XCL_021") > 50000
  )
GROUP BY T3."XCL_008", T3."XCL_009"
ORDER BY SUM(T1."XCL_018") DESC
LIMIT 3
